requirements.requirement: Read the Kalshi demo REST Trade API at the documented base URL.
requirements.implementation: app/config.py and collector/kalshi.py hard-code the official demo bases https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 (recommended) and https://demo-api.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 (also supported); scripts/kalshi_demo_client.py documents both.
requirements.verification: Both URLs match the official API-environments table (page fetched 2026-11-27); tools/verify_site.py rejects any snapshot whose api_base is not an official demo host.

requirements.requirement: Read the Kalshi demo WebSocket API at the documented URL.
requirements.implementation: collector/kalshi_auth.py builds the documented handshake signature (timestamp + GET + /trade-api/ws/v2); tools/probe_api.py records the actual outcome of an unauthenticated handshake on both demo WS roots.
requirements.verification: Official docs state every WebSocket connection must authenticate during the handshake; data/verification.json records HTTP 401 token_authentication_failure for unsigned attempts, so no live WS stream is claimed without credentials.

requirements.requirement: Track the highest dollar-amount live events.
requirements.implementation: dashboard.html ranks events by volume.notional_24h_est (24h contracts x mid price; assets/js/dashboard.js) and the five topic pages rank by the same measure (assets/js/category.js); the archived collector generation used est_volume_24h_dollars (collector/collect.py).
requirements.verification: Every figure carries the caveat "computed estimate - not an official Kalshi dollar-volume field" in the table tooltip and footer, and data/meta.json volume_metric_note states the formula. The metric is derived, not an official field, hence partial.

requirements.requirement: Restrict coverage to gas prices, elections, culture, crypto and golf only.
requirements.implementation: app/topics.py restricts discovery to the five brief topics; the site publishes exactly five topic pages (gas-prices, elections, culture, crypto, golf) plus live mirrors under live/topics/.
requirements.verification: GET /search/tags_by_categories on the demo host (recorded in data/verification.json) shows gas = Commodities/'Oil & Gas', elections = Elections, crypto = Crypto, golf = Sports/Golf, and no Culture category - culture maps to official Entertainment (flagged, not invented).

requirements.requirement: Alert on contract price swings of at least $0.10 in either direction.
requirements.implementation: Threshold $0.10 both directions: data/snapshot.json threshold=0.1, dashboard.html badge "Threshold >= $0.10", collector/alerts.py and app/alerts.py seed alerts from 1-minute candles, live/assets/js/data.js converts dollars to cents exactly once.
requirements.verification: python3 -m pytest passed 80 tests (threshold edges included) and live/tests/check_live.py passed 16 pages / 0 failures on 2026-11-27; check_live.py guards the dollar-to-cent conversion against off-by-100 regressions.

requirements.requirement: Present the alerts as a simple real-time scrolling chat.
requirements.implementation: Two scrolling chats on dashboard.html (#chat-all for every >= $0.10 move, newest first, pause control) and on live/alerts.html (#chatAll); both poll the public demo API and fall back to the committed snapshot seed.
requirements.verification: Headless render of dashboard.html on 2026-11-27 produced 36 seeded alert messages from data/snapshot.json alerts_seed with 0 script errors; every message links to its API record.

requirements.requirement: Provide a second filtered chat containing only the events the model scores as high ROI.
requirements.implementation: The second chat shows only opportunities passing the model filter - ROI on risk >= 25% with entry price $0.10-$0.90 (collector/alerts.py evaluates ROI with the official taker fee formula; rule text in data/alerts.json high_roi_rule and on the chat footer).
requirements.verification: Rule and band are stated on the page; pytest covers the qualification logic. When live quotes are absent the chat renders empty - it never fabricates picks (headless check: 26 scored picks after the quote-shape fix, flagged F-21).

requirements.requirement: Keep tracking live events until they resolve, and record whether they resolved yes or no.
requirements.implementation: resolutions.html lists the tracked open markets first, then every logged settled market with its yes/no result, from data/snapshot.json (this session's fix; it previously read an empty collector file); each topic page keeps a resolution log and live/resolutions.html serves the live generation.
requirements.verification: data/snapshot.json carried 44,192 settled in-scope markets (result yes/no only) on 2026-11-27; headless render showed 346 rows (128 open + 218 logged settled), KPI Resolved (30d) = 44,192, 0 script errors; tools/verify_site.py fails if any resolution result is not yes/no.

requirements.requirement: Automate simulated trades to test different strategies.
requirements.implementation: app/paper.py and portfolio.html strategy sleeves open paper positions on model picks, exit on target/stop and settle on official results; portfolio.html also ships a candle backtester; data/backtest.json records the automated run.
requirements.verification: The 2026-11-27T19:03Z run recorded 37 closed and 1 open simulated trades across momentum / mean-reversion / favorite-drift with by-strategy, by-topic, by-price and by-side attribution; pytest (80 tests) covers paper, strategy and fee logic. The run's optimism limits are flagged (F-20).

requirements.implementation: collector/trading.py sync_demo_portfolio() reads GET /portfolio/balance and GET /portfolio/positions with signed requests when KALSHI_DEMO_API_KEY_ID / KALSHI_DEMO_PRIVATE_KEY secrets exist; otherwise data/portfolio.json publishes configured:false.
requirements.verification: Requires repository secrets this session cannot create; no balance or position is displayed anywhere on the site. Published as a flagged open item, never filled in.

requirements.requirement: Analyse results and categorise trades / build strategies by trade type.
requirements.implementation: data/analytics.json attributes P&L by strategy, topic, side and price bucket; portfolio.html renders equity, attribution tables and CSV export; strategy definitions live in data/strategies.json (5 sleeves).
requirements.verification: Headless render of portfolio.html on 2026-11-27 showed 9 attribution rows with 0 script errors; fee attribution uses the official taker fee formula (tests/test_fees.py); backtest attribution cross-checks the same categories.

requirements.requirement: Execute trades on events and track their performance.
requirements.implementation: tools/execute_demo_order.py posts a signed order to POST /portfolio/events/orders using the official Create Order (V2) payload when demo credentials exist; paper orders always run and are performance-tracked.
requirements.verification: Endpoint and payload verified against the official Create Order (V2) reference (page fetched 2026-11-27). No order has been sent - credentials are absent - so execution stays flagged, not claimed.

requirements.requirement: Live interactive dashboard with price graphs; x axis time with seconds/minutes/hours ranges, y axis contract price.
requirements.implementation: dashboard.html chart: x = UTC time with switchable windows 30s / 5m / 15m / 1h / 6h / 24h (assets/js/dashboard.js + assets/js/live.js), y = contract price; second-level ticks in 30s/5m come from GET /markets/trades, 1-minute and 1-hour candles from GET .../candlesticks; live/market.html adds 6h / 24h / 7d.
requirements.verification: Window buttons and y-domain verified in markup and code, rendered headlessly on 2026-11-27; candle intervals 1/60/1440 minutes match the official candlesticks reference (fetched 2026-11-27).

requirements.requirement: Show current liquidity and how many contracts are available at a given price.
requirements.implementation: The order-book ladder on dashboard.html (refreshed every 15s via GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook) and live/liquidity.html show contracts resting at each price level on both sides, with best bid/ask and spread.
requirements.verification: Structure matches the official orderbook reference (orderbook_fp.yes_dollars / no_dollars arrays of [price, contracts], depth 0-100; page fetched 2026-11-27); the page states that Kalshi returns bids only and a YES ask is implied at 1 - NO bid.
